title: Behind-the-scenes tidy-up
summary: No changes you will notice. The checks that catch mistakes before a release are stronger, and the guides for people who work on the intranet are up to date.

changed: The guides for people who work on the intranet are up to date, with an index and new guides to the People and Communications areas.
fixed: Approved volunteer hours no longer fail when a timesheet's member no longer exists.

internal_notes: Larastan now type-checks the four modules and the milestone scripts; 18 problems were fixed and none are in a baseline.
CI also runs the tests on PHP 8.4, the version Cloudron runs, and the Composer cache works (it never saved before).
Removed unused packages: concurrently, @laravel/multiplex and laravel/pail.

New scripts/laragon-env.ps1 sets Laragon's PHP and Node for a terminal. The short Cursor commands moved up one folder, skills write temporary files outside the repo, and the approved plan is always posted on the Epic.
Issue forms add their type label, and a new workflow adds the chosen area label. Dependabot security PRs are retargeted to the dependencies branch.
The holding page doc is folded into the Cloudron guide, and the public LMS inventory no longer lists app IDs or software versions.
